remarks: Welcome to 35 Woodway Road Unit A-17; a special home. This 2 bed, 1.5 bath townhome has spacious rooms, wonderful light throughout the day, beautiful hardwood flooring on both levels & we just painted w/ neutral colors. The updated, modern Eat-In Kit has stone counters, all stainless steel appliances & ceiling fan. The living room/dining area combo is very large & has a nice balcony w/ western exposure & wall a/c unit. The convenient half bath completes this open & spacious main level. The Upper level has 2 generously sized bedrooms w/ hardwood floors, very large closets (1 customized), a linen closet, fully tiled bath & pull down stair to an attic. A real treat is the 1 car underneath garage with direct access into the unit, including storage and washer, dryer. The grounds are well maintained & the association has lots of parking. Low HOA fees and reasonable property taxes are another reason to make Woodland Terrace your new home, not to mention your in the heart of Fabulous Springdale with convenient access to shopping, entertainment, eateries & transportation. Come on, take a look. You'll be glad you did!
